descriptionChirho: The city of Gibeah in the territory of Benjamin, prominent in the narrative of the Levite's concubine (Judges 19-20) and as the home of Saul; includes all prepositional and article variants.
The city of Geba, a distinct Levitical city in Benjamin, sometimes confused with Gibeah due to similar orthography but a separate settlement.
Appellative use of the word as a common noun meaning 'hill' rather than as a proper place name.
